data.name: UseLithifyNotCalled
data.value: No Lithify commands are registered. Call UseLithify() on the host application builder before Build().
data.comment: InvalidOperationException thrown by RunLithifyAsync when UseLithify was never called.

data.name: NoServiceRegistered
data.value: No implementation of '{0}' is registered. Add a parser, a renderer and a template engine to the Lithify builder (for example UseMarkdig().UseHtmlRenderer().UseHandlebarsNet()).
data.comment: InvalidOperationException thrown when a command needs a service that no plugin package has registered.
